text:
Sacar in hombros por my door
I looked ayer a ataúd,
where among flowers iba dead
   my youth.


Perdida all fuerza física
the vi in my brazos expirar.
as a pobre novia tísica
   ¡of tanto amar!


over his body, the postreras
roses of autumn deshojé.
and among memories and quimeras
   the amortajé.


for no ver his face amado
tendí a pañuelo por his faz.
and exclamé in tears bañado:
   -¡descansa in peace!


Lenta the lluvia descendía…
the golondrina iba a partir…
and until the brisa parecía
among the árboles gemir.


Cármenes viejos of Granada,
in a crepúsculo otoñal,
vieron perderse in the enramada
   his funeral.


Almas sedientas of ideales
that tanto amó my youth…
¡Deshojar roses otoñales
   in his ataúd!


and you, incansable peregrino.
that the world cruzas without cesar,
¡if ves his entierro in your path,
   ponte a rezar!


Sacar in hombros por my door
I looked ayer afternoon a ataúd,
where among flowers iba dead
   my youth.

translation.title: Elegía of the youth
